description: Header file defining classes for clustering objects in Euclidean space, including EuclideanCluster and EuclideanClustering, with algorithms based on minimum spanning trees and Kruskal's algorithm.

classes.name: EuclideanCluster
classes.description: Represents a cluster of objects in Euclidean space, providing methods to update, remove, and compute cluster metadata such as center, mean object, average distance, and standard deviation.

classes.name: EuclideanClustering
classes.description: Manages a collection of EuclideanClusters, performing clustering based on minimum spanning trees, with methods to update object positions, remove objects, and generate clusters using Kruskal's algorithm.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Adds or updates the location of an object in the cluster or clustering.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an object from the cluster or clustering.

methods.name: GetCenter
methods.description: Returns the Euclidean center of the cluster.

methods.name: GetMeanObject
methods.description: Returns the object closest to the cluster's center.

methods.name: GetAverageDistance
methods.description: Returns the average distance of objects from the cluster center.

methods.name: GetStandardDeviation
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of distances from the center.

methods.name: SetLaxity
methods.description: Sets the laxity factor used in clustering to determine edge length thresholds.

methods.name: GenerateClusters
methods.description: Generates clusters based on the minimum spanning tree and edge length thresholds.
